summary: Backcountry skier caught and injured in an avalanche on Berthoud Pass; self-extracted from the debris but unable to ski out
responding_agency: Grand County SAR + Grand County Sheriff's Office + Grand County EMS + East Grand Fire Protection District
notes: Date verified: 2024-12-03 was a Tuesday, matching the article's Tuesday, December 3 (published 2024-12-04). GPS locate via skier's cell phone; treated for multiple injuries and mild hypothermia; evacuated to Highway 40 by rescue toboggan and rope uphaul systems. SnowBrains Mines Peak account (posted 2024-12-05, CAIC photos): slide 2 ft deep x 600 ft wide x ~800 vertical ft at Mines 2; a second large slide (Mines 1) occurred Dec 1; slide caught/injured the Dec-3 skier. MERGE (run 365): snowboarder.com Dec-2024 Berthoud Pass avalanche account appended (same incident: Dec 3, 3:15 p.m. GCSAR response, GPS locate, toboggan/rope uphaul).
